name: Cea (Spain)
description: Square flag divided diagonally by a blue band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, yellow above and below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cea (a black bend on yellow and waves).
history: Municipal flag of Cea; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: broad band from the upper hoist to the lower fly
Cea arms — black bend on yellow above waves
cap of the crown of the arms
